auth.welcomeTitle: Baro, bar oo maamul madrasadaada meel keliya
auth.welcomeBody: La soco xifdiga, qaad xaadirinta, qiimee tajwiidka oo ururi lacagta — waxaa loo sameeyay madrasadaha Kenya iyo Bariga Afrika.
auth.parentAccountHint: La soco horumarka ilmahaaga oo bixi lacagta

auth.demoCodeNotice: Nuqul tijaabo ah: emayl lama dirin. Koodhkaagu waa {{code}}.

auth.registerMadrasaBody: Adiga ayaa noqonaya milkiilaha. Isla markaaba waad casuumi kartaa macallimiin, waadna ku dari kartaa arday.

auth.confirmEmailNote: Madrasadaada waa la sameeyay. Waxaad u baahan tahay oo kaliya inaad xaqiijiso ciwaanka.

billing.trialBody: Kadib waa {{price}} bishii si aad u sii diiwaan geliso arday oo aad lacag u ururiso.
billing.pastDueTitle: Lacag bixin ayaa loo baahan yahay
billing.pastDueBody: Tijaabadu way dhammaatay. Bixi {{price}} si aad u sii wadato.
billing.graceBody: Weli waxaad madrasada u maamuli kartaa dhowr maalmood. Hadda bixi si aadan u joogsan.
billing.restrictedTitle: Diiwaangelinta iyo qaansheegashada waa la joojiyay

billing.cancelledBody: Wakhti kasta dib u bilow. Xogtaadu waa sida ay ahayd.
billing.graceEnds: Qalabka maamulku wuxuu xirmayaa {{date}}, {{count}} maalmood kadib lacag bixinta la seegay.

billing.oneMonthOfAccess: Hal bil oo helitaan buuxa ah madrasadaada oo dhan.
billing.stkSent: Geli PIN-kaaga M-Pesa si aad u ansixiso {{price}}.
billing.cardProcessing: Tani waxay qaadanaysaa dhowr ilbiriqsi. Ha xirin abka.
billing.paymentSuccessBody: Madrasadaadu waa la bixiyay bisha soo socota. Mahadsanid.
billing.paymentFailedBody: Lacag bixintu ma dhicin. Lacag kama bixin akoonkaaga.
billing.noPayments: Weli lacag bixin ma jirto. Lacagtaada koowaad waxay dhacaysaa marka tijaabadu dhammaato.
billing.autoRenew: Si toos ah ayuu u cusboonaanayaa
billing.ownerOnly: Kaliya milkiilaha madrasada ayaa beddeli kara rukunka.
billing.cardHostedNote: Kaarkaaga waxaad gelin doontaa bogga lacag-bixinta ee ammaan ah ee Paystack. ILMORA ma arkto mana kaydiso lambarka kaarkaaga.

admin.webOnlyBody: Guddiga maamulaha madasha wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa browser, halkaas oo ay jirto meel lagu akhriyo ka hor inta aan go'aan laga gaarin dugsi dhan. App-kan waxaa loogu talagalay madrasadaha iyo qoysaska.
admin.overviewSubtitle: Dhammaan dugsiyada hal mar. Tirooyin kaliya: diiwaanka ardayda halkan laguma muujiyo.
admin.madrasasSubtitle: Raadi dugsiyada oo dib u eeg xaaladdooda.
admin.feesCollectedCaption: Loo bixiyay madrasadaha iyadoo loo marayo app-ka
admin.deliveryStalled: {{n}} ogeysiis ayaa sugayay in ka badan 10 daqiiqo. Hubi qaybiyaha.
admin.deliveryFailures: Wixii ku guuldareystay isku dayo kadib: {{email}} iimayl, {{sms}} SMS.
admin.noMadrasasBody: Isku day raadin ama xaalad kale.
admin.notFoundBody: Waxaa laga yaabaa in si joogto ah loo tirtiray. Ku noqo liiska.
admin.noActions: Madrasadan waa la tirtiray. Diiwaankeeda hubinta oo keliya ayaa haray.

explain.suspend: Hakintu isla markiiba way dhaqan gashaa, dibna waa loo celin karaa. Shaqaalaha, waalidiinta iyo ardaydu way waayaan gelitaanka ilaa madrasada dib loo soo celiyo; waxba lama tirtiro.
explain.schedule_deletion: Madrasada waa la xirayaa, diiwaankeedana waxaa la hayaa 30 maalmood, kadibna si joogto ah ayaa loo tirtirayaa. Ilaa inta lagu jiro waa la soo celin karaa. Milkiilaha waa la ogeysiinayaa.
explain.reinstate: Wuxuu u celinayaa gelitaanka caadiga ah qof kasta oo madrasadan ku jira.
explain.purge: Si joogto ah ayuu u tirtirayaa diiwaanka madrasadan. Dib looma celin karo. Qor magaca madrasada sida saxda ah si aad u xaqiijiso.

admin.reasonHint: Waxaa lagu diiwaangelinayaa diiwaanka hubinta, oo ay la socdaan magacaaga iyo waqtiga.
admin.confirmMismatch: Taasi si sax ah uguma eka magaca madrasada.
admin.changed: Waa la sameeyay. Madrasadu hadda waa: {{status}}.
admin.auditSubtitle: Tallaabo kasta oo madasha lagu diiwaangeliyay, kuwa ugu cusub marka hore. Diiwaanka lama beddeli karo.
admin.noAuditBody: Tallaabooyinku halkan ayay ka muuqan doonaan markay dhacaan.

aiFeedback.consentBodyParent: Marka la shido, duubista akhriska ilmahaaga waxaa loo diraa Gemini AI ee Google si loogu helo jawaabcelin tajwiid oo toos ah. Magac lama diro, qiimeynta macallinkuna had iyo jeer waa tan kama dambaysta ah. Waad dami kartaa wakhti kasta.
aiFeedback.consentBodyStaff: Shid kaliya marka waalidku bixiyo oggolaansho qoran. Duubista waxaa loo diraa Gemini AI ee Google si jawaabcelin toos ah loo helo; magac lama diro.
aiFeedback.notConsented: Jawaabcelinta AI waa ka xiran tahay ardaygan, sidaa darteed duubista looma dirin jawaabcelin toos ah. Macallinka ayaa dib u eegi doona.
aiFeedback.unavailable: Jawaabcelinta tooska ah lama heli karin markan. Macallinka ayaa dib u eegi doona akhriskan.
aiFeedback.notHeard: Qaybta lama maqli karin duubistan. Si cad u akhri, adigoo u dhow taleefanka, oo isku day mar kale. Macallinka ayaa sidoo kale dib u eegi doona.

sponsor.title: Kafaala arday
sponsor.subtitle: Sadaqo lagu bixiyo lacagta madrasada ardayga
sponsor.menuSubtitle: Ku bixi lacagta arday sadaqo ahaan
sponsor.intro: Qoysaska ardaydan waxay oggolaadeen in la caawiyo. Ma arki doontid magacyadooda, iyaguna ma arki doonaan kaaga: waxaa keliya loo sheegaa in kafiil bixiyey. Hadiyaddaadu waxay bixisaa biilka xiga ee ardayga, waxaadna helaysaa rasiid.
sponsor.emptyBody: Arday kasta oo liiska ku jiray waa la kafaalay. Alle ha abaal mariyo bixiyeyaasha.
sponsor.thanksBody: Sadaqadaada {{amount}} waxay bixisay lacagta arday. Rasiidka {{receipt}}.
sponsor.cardHint: Ardaygan liiska kafiillada ku dar haddii qoysku u baahan yahay caawimo lacageed. Kafiilladu ma arkaan magaca ama sawirka ardayga.
sponsor.noteLabel: Fariin gaaban oo kafiillada loogu talagalay (ikhtiyaari)
sponsor.notePlaceholder: tusaale: Wuxuu doonayaa inuu dhammeeyo Juz Amma sannadkan
sponsor.noteHint: Magacyo ama faahfaahin aqoonsata ardayga ha qorin.

reciteAlong.title: La akhri
reciteAlong.subtitle: Meeshaadu way iftiintaa markaad akhrinayso
reciteAlong.entry: Ku celceli suurad oo arag eray kasta oo iftiimaya markaad akhrido. Waxba lama duubo lamana qiimeeyo.
reciteAlong.perfect: Ma sha Allah! Eray kasta, siday u kala horreeyaan.
reciteAlong.finished_one: Waad dhammeysay. {{count}} eray waxaa laga yaabaa in la booday: waxaa hoos looga xariiqay casaan.
reciteAlong.finished_other: Waad dhammeysay. {{count}} eray waxaa laga yaabaa in la booday: waxaa hoos looga xariiqay casaan.
reciteAlong.note: Waa celcelis oo keliya. Eray la sheegay in la booday waxaa laga yaabaa inaan si fiican loo maqal. Macallinkaaga ayaa qiimeeya akhriska aad duubtay.
reciteAlong.needsConsent: La akhri waxay u baahan tahay adeegga codka Google ee taleefankan, kaas oo maqla codkaaga. Waalidkaa ka codso inuu marka hore oggolaado faallada AI.
reciteAlong.noPermission: Oggolow makarafoonka si aad ula akhrido.
reciteAlong.unavailable: Aqoonsiga codka hadda lama heli karo. Dhowr daqiiqo kadib isku day.
